verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
verses.translation: Ha'. Mim.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.translation: By the Clear Book.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.translation: We revealed it on a Blessed Night, for We were intent on warning;

verses.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.translation: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined

verses.arabic: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.translation: by Our command. Verily, We were set to send a Messenger

verses.arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translation: as a Mercy from your Lord. Surely He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing,

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.

verses.arabic: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: There is no god but He: He gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.translation: (But the fact is, they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke,

verses.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.translation: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: (People will then say): “Our Lord, remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.”

verses.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger came to them clearly expounding the Truth,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: yet they turned away from him and said: “This is a well-tutored madman.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.translation: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while, (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.translation: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing, that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.translation: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger came to them

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.translation: (and said): “Deliver to me Allah's servants. I am a trustworthy Messenger to you,

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority (as a Messenger).

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.translation: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.

verses.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.translation: But if you do not believe what I say, leave me alone (and desist from laying hands on me).”

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.translation: Then he called upon his Lord: “These are a criminal people.”

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.translation: (He was told): “Set out with My servants by night for you will certainly be pursued.

verses.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.translation: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.”

verses.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: How many gardens did they leave behind, and how many fountains

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.translation: and sown fields and splendid mansions,

verses.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
verses.translation: and the life of ease in which they took delight!

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

verses.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth. They were granted no respite.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.translation: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement,

verses.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.translation: from Pharaoh who was most prominent among the prodigals.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: We knowingly exalted them (i.e., the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed these people say:

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.translation: “This is our first and only death, and we shall never be raised again.

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.translation: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.translation: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translation: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translation: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.translation: The tree of al-Zaqqum

verses.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.translation: shall be the food of the sinful.

verses.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.translation: Like dregs of oil, it will boil in their bellies

verses.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.translation: like boiling water.

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: “Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.translation: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.

verses.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.translation: Taste this, you are a person mighty and noble!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.translation: This is what you used to doubt.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verses.translation: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: amidst gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.translation: Attired in silk and brocade, they shall be arrayed face to face.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.translation: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair, wide-eyed maidens.

verses.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.translation: While resting in security, they shall call for all kinds of fruit.

verses.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.translation: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: (O Prophet), We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.translation: Wait, then; they too are waiting.
